Class SlotGroupPanelRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.inject.SlotGroupPanelRegistry
@Internal public final class SlotGroupPanelRegistry extends Object
Library-owned registry of SlotGroupContext SlotGroupPanelAdapters that declare targeting via .on(SlotGroupCategory...). Listens once on ScreenEvents.AFTER_INIT and dispatches click + render to the slot-group adapters whose targeting matches the slot groups present on each opened AbstractContainerScreen.

Post-§0042 split companion to MenuKit's ScreenPanelRegistry. The two registries are parallel — MenuKit's handles MenuContext adapter dispatch on vanilla screens; this one handles SlotGroupContext adapter dispatch. They register independent ScreenEvents.AFTER_INIT listeners; both fire per screen-open; each runs its own orphan checkpoint and dispatches its own input/render pass.

Behavior change vs pre-split. Before §0042, slot-group click dispatch happened inside MenuKit-side ScreenPanelRegistry's click hook, before the modal-eat decision — so slot-group clicks fired even when a MenuContext modal was eating the click. After the split, MenuKit's listener registers first; if MenuKit eats (modal up), Fabric's allowMouseClick stops invoking and this registry's listener never fires — slot-group click is skipped under modal. This is the correct UX (modal blocks all interaction) and matches user expectations. Documented in 16a REPORT §3.

    • init

      public static void init()
      Registers the library-owned ScreenEvents.AFTER_INIT listener. Called once from MKCClient.onInitializeClient. After this, any region-based slot-group adapter that declared targeting will dispatch on matching screens without the consumer writing per-screen boilerplate.

    • renderMatchingPanels

      public static void renderMatchingPanels(net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractContainerScreen<?> screen, net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphicsExtractor graphics, int mouseX, int mouseY)
      Called from SlotGroupPanelRenderMixin at the same injection point as MenuKit's MKPanelRenderMixin. Dispatches all matching SlotGroupContext adapters for the current screen. Both mixins fire per render — MenuKit's first (renders MenuContext panels), this one second (renders slot-group panels on top).

      Re-resolves slot groups per frame. Creative-tab switches and other dynamic menu mutations change menu.slots; caching the resolved map at screen-open would produce stale bounds. Per-frame resolution is cheap (resolvers do slot-index subList slicing on menu.slots).

      Public visibility required because the mixin is in a different package (mixin) from this class (inject).

    • validateTargetingDeclared

      public static void validateTargetingDeclared()
      Validates that every slot-group adapter constructed during init declared its targeting via .on(SlotGroupCategory...). Throws IllegalStateException naming the orphan panel IDs, failing the client boot visibly.
